sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 18–24), with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the tenor, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 53–110).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 49), with the alto's line in the soprano, a step lower. Soprano: the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor; perfect cadence in G major at bar 78; perfect cadence in E♭ minor at bar 83; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 94; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 96
